title: careem  restaurant
description: A leading Middle Eastern mobility platform sought to evolve beyond traditional ride-hailing into a comprehensive digital ecosystem connecting transportation, food delivery, grocery shopping, digital payments, and everyday services through a single mobile application. CISIN designed and implemented an enterprise-grade Super App platform integrating transportation, deliveries, payments, merchant services, customer engagement, and operational intelligence into one centralized ecosystem. The platform was designed to support millions of users, real-time operations, secure payments, multilingual experiences, and scalable expansion across multiple markets.
challenge: The client needed to scale its mobility platform beyond traditional ride-hailing while supporting millions of users, captains, merchants, delivery partners, and financial transactions across multiple countries. Key challenges included scaling infrastructure for millions of daily requests, enabling low-latency real-time ride matching, implementing dynamic pricing, coordinating transportation and delivery services through one platform, processing secure multi-currency payments, maintaining reliable GPS tracking and live ETA calculations, supporting multilingual experiences, providing operational intelligence, and ensuring reliability during festivals, holidays, and peak traffic conditions while maintaining security, compliance, and user privacy.
solution:
CISIN designed and built an enterprise-grade Super App structured across three operational layers: a Customer Experience Platform, Captain & Delivery Partner Platform, and Merchant & Operations Console. The solution unified ride booking, food and grocery delivery, parcel services, digital wallet payments, real-time tracking, merchant management, fleet operations, fraud monitoring, financial reconciliation, loyalty programs, personalized recommendations, and customer engagement.

The platform was built using a cloud-native microservices architecture with Kubernetes orchestration, AWS/Microsoft Azure deployment, real-time GPS tracking, Google Maps API integration, event-driven architecture, AI-powered recommendations, machine-learning demand prediction, digital wallet integration, multiple payment gateways, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, and role-based access control.
